sentences.text:
None for the respondent No.1 and 2.
 ORDER
With the consent of both learned counsel for the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

2. This appeal has been filed by the claimants/appellants under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the award dated 07.10.2006 passed in Claim Case No.657/2005 by the 8th Additional M.A.C.T., Jabalpur, seeking enhancement of compensation.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that tribunal has awarded compensation amount only 20,000/- which is on lower side.
It is urged that tribunal has not awarded appropriate amount.
On above grounds, it is urged that compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably enhanced.
4. Learned counsel for respondent No.3/Insurance Company submits that compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and no enhancement is required.
Therefore, appeal filed by the appellant be 2 MA-399-2007 dismissed.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused record of the case.
6. In view of evidence on record, including nature of injury, no enhancement is required.

Hence,
appeal filed by the appellant is dismissed.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
